newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may upgrade Unocal unit debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may upgrade Unocal unit debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it placed the debt of Unocal Corp's Union Oil Co of California on rating watch-up for a possible upgrade.
The current senior unsecured debt rating is Triple B Plus and the current commercial paper rating is D Two. The action affects nearly $3.2 billion of debt as of June 30, 1996.
Duff & Phelps said its rating watch action follows Unocal's announced letter of intent to divest Unocal's West Coast downstream assets.
The sale, along with a subsequent $800 million debt reduction, appears to have positive credit implications for the company, the rating agency said.
Unocal is an oil and gas exploration and production company.
